_comment: NX Player — English dictionary. Key = the French text of the code ("…"_t), value = English. Missing keys stay French.
DFF compressé en DST : non pris en charg: DST-compressed DFF: not supported (decompress it to raw DSD)
DFF : en-tête incomplet ou format non pr: DFF: incomplete header or unsupported format
Astuce MT VAD : réglez Inputs / Outputs: MT VAD tip: set Inputs / Outputs to 2 channels and Latency to 4 ms (192) in MT VAD Preferences to avoid the ANEMAN error at high sample rates.
Astuce RME : activez « DSD Direct » sur: RME tip: enable « DSD Direct » on your ADI-2 Pro only if you use an external analogue volume control (DSD Direct disables the hardware volume of the line outputs).
Bit-perfect USB : DSD en DoP 1.0 jusqu'a: Bit-perfect USB: DSD as DoP 1.0 up to DSD256 (depending on the rates the ADI-2 reports), short 150 ms sync, bit-perfect PCM in integer mode.
DSD converti en DXD 352,8 kHz (+6 dB, fi: DSD converted to DXD 352.8 kHz (+6 dB, minimum-phase filter): the ADI-2's EQ, loudness and crossfeed stay available (they do not work in DSD).
Bit-perfect et stabilité : le DSD (DSD64: Bit-perfect and stability: DSD (DSD64 to DSD512) is converted to DXD 352.8 kHz (64-bit linear-phase FIR, adjustable gain with limiter), PCM 44.1 to 192 kHz stays bit-perfect. No DoP markers on the network.
Signature chaleureuse : DSD et PCM porté: Warm signature: DSD and PCM taken to DXD 352.8 / 384 kHz by a minimum-phase filter (no pre-ringing), optional even-harmonic stage (−90 dB) and a slight softening above 18 kHz.
DSD en DoP 1.0, sécurité RAVENNA : tampo: DSD as DoP 1.0, RAVENNA safety: 2048-sample buffer, 2 channels, 1.5 s of DoP silence at each rate change so the PTP clock can lock.
Bit à bit, sans passer par le flottant: Bit for bit, never through floating point
Lecture disque / réseau, tampon circulai: Disk / network reads, 8 MB lock-free ring buffer
Harmoniques paires −90 dB · plateau −0,5: Even harmonics −90 dB · −0.5 dB shelf > 18 kHz
64 bits, débrayable dans les réglages: 64-bit, can be switched off in the settings
Bit-perfect : le DAC reçoit exactement l: Bit-perfect: the DAC receives exactly the file's data
Haute qualité : sans perte, mais pas bit: High quality: lossless, but not bit-perfect
Qualité réduite : source avec pertes ou: Reduced quality: lossy source or system mixer
DoP : le flux DSD voyage intact dans des: DoP: the DSD stream travels intact in 24-bit PCM words at
Le DAC n'accepte ni DSD natif ni DoP à c: The DAC accepts neither native DSD nor DoP at this rate:
Source en virgule flottante : quantifica: Floating-point source: quantised to the DAC's resolution
Mise en veille : non gérée sur ce systèm: Sleep: not managed on this system
Plein : accepté nativement · contour :: Filled: native  ·  outline: DSD over DoP  ·  glow: playing
Même réseau Wi-Fi que cet ordinateur. Bi: Same Wi-Fi network as this computer. Library, playback, volume, A-B loop and Anubis / RME profiles from the phone's browser, nothing to install.
Layout exported: put immersive.json in a .nxtheme theme folder to share it
album(s) du NAS seront retirés de la bi: NAS album(s) will be removed from the library. The files stay on the server.
morceau(x) du NAS retiré(s) de la bibli: NAS track(s) removed from the library
Retirer tous les albums de ce serveur (: Remove all albums of this server (
Retirer le serveur de la bibliothèque: Remove the server from the library
album(s) de ce serveur seront retirés d: album(s) of this server will be removed from the library (the files stay on the NAS).
Fichiers locaux : retirez leur dossier d: Local files: remove their folder in Settings › Library
NX Remote : piloter depuis le téléphone: NX Remote: control from your phone (QR code)
Contrôlez NX Player depuis votre télépho: Control NX Player from your phone, on the same Wi-Fi network: enable NX Remote then scan the QR code. The server only starts on demand.
Ajoutez un dossier de musique ou connect: Add a music folder or connect a source in the sidebar.
Cliquez sur le cœur d'un morceau, ou cli: Click a track's heart, or right click › Add to favourites, or drag tracks onto Favourites.
Importez vos playlists depuis une source: Import your playlists from a source, or create one.
Le catalogue est vide (dossier Catalog i: The catalogue is empty (Catalog folder not found next to the application).
Aucun plugin dans votre dossier pour l'i: No plug-in in your folder yet. Install some from the Catalogue, import a folder or a .zip archive, or write your own: a manifest.json and a plugin.js are enough (see docs/PLUGINS.md).
ce plugin est livré avec NX Player et ne: this plug-in ships with NX Player and cannot be removed
manifest.json introuvable dans ce plugin: manifest.json not found in this plug-in
Activez ou désactivez en un clic. Les th: Switch on or off in one click. Themes apply at once, plug-ins appear in their slots.
Des plug-ins en plus, installés dans vot: More plug-ins, installed in your folder in one click. Your own (imported) ones appear under « Installed ».
Aucun serveur UPnP / DLNA à cette adress: No UPnP / DLNA server at this address
Recherche des serveurs UPnP / DLNA du ré: Searching the network for UPnP / DLNA servers…
Aucun serveur trouvé : entrez l'adresse: No server found: enter the NAS's IP address
Choisissez la langue de l'interface et s: Choose the interface language and its look. Everything can be changed later in the settings.
Comment voulez-vous organiser le lecteur: How would you like the player organised?
NX Player a détecté votre interface : ac: NX Player found your interface: enable the optimal profile in one click.
Indiquez où se trouve votre musique : un: Tell us where your music is: a local folder and / or a NAS / Jellyfin server on the network.
Barre latérale étendue, lecteur en bas: Wide sidebar, player at the bottom
Barre latérale en icônes, plus de place: Icon sidebar, more room for the music
Barre de lecture en haut, à la Roon: Player bar on top, Roon style
PCM à la fréquence du fichier en accès e: PCM at the file's rate in exclusive access, DSD natively or as DoP when the DAC accepts it, otherwise converted to 64-bit DXD. Connect a Merging Anubis or an RME ADI-2 Pro: their dedicated profiles will show up here.
Disque interne ou externe, partage SMB /: Internal or external drive, mounted SMB / NFS share
Copier ces morceaux du serveur dans le d: Copy these tracks from the server to the download folder, for offline listening
Disques internes, disques externes et pa: Internal drives, external drives and mounted network shares (SMB / NFS / AFP). Folders are watched: additions, deletions and changes show up by themselves.
Serveurs de musique du réseau local (Min: Music servers of the local network (MinimServer, Asset, Synology, QNAP, JRiver, Jellyfin…). Tracks are streamed over HTTP by the NX Player engine, so bit-perfect. For an SMB share, just add the mounted folder under Local files.
Ce serveur n'est plus disponible : relan: This server is no longer available: search again.
Adresse IP du NAS ou URL de description: NAS IP address or description URL (e.g. 192.168.1.20)
Aucun serveur trouvé pour l'instant. Vér: No server found yet. Check that the NAS's UPnP / DLNA server is enabled (MinimServer, Synology Media Server, Asset…); if your network filters discovery, enter the NAS's IP address above.
FLAC jusqu'à 24 bits / 192 kHz, lu par l: FLAC up to 24-bit / 192 kHz, played by NX Player's bit-perfect engine (automatic DAC rate switching). The Qobuz API requires partner application credentials (app_id / app_secret) issued by Qobuz.
FLAC (et FLAC Max jusqu'à 24 / 192 en DA: FLAC (and FLAC Max up to 24 / 192 over DASH) played by the bit-perfect engine. Sign-in with a code on link.tidal.com and a client_id issued by Tidal (developer programme). Encrypted (DRM) streams are not supported.
Recherche, bibliothèque et playlists via: Search, library and playlists through Spotify's official Web API (PKCE sign-in in your browser, redirect http://127.0.0.1:43821/callback). Playback is handed to your Spotify Connect device: Spotify does not deliver audio streams to third-party apps, so these tracks do not go through the bit-perfect engine.
Recherche et playlists via l'API YouTube: Search and playlists through the YouTube Data v3 API (Google API key). Playback opens on music.youtube.com: YouTube's terms forbid extracting the audio, so these tracks do not go through the engine.
Double-cliquez sur un morceau : il est l: Double-click a track: it starts on your Spotify device (Spotify app open, Premium account required for remote control; otherwise the track opens in Spotify).
Importer mes playlists dans la bibliothè: Import my playlists into the library
ASIO et WASAPI exclusif (Windows), CoreA: ASIO and exclusive WASAPI (Windows), CoreAudio + Hog Mode (macOS), ALSA hw (Linux) bypass the system mixer.
Un périphérique reconnu reçoit des régla: A recognised device gets dedicated settings (as in Roon): Merging (« Merging », « Anubis », « RAVENNA », « VAD ») and RME (« RME », « ADI-2 »).
SACD 0 dB = −6 dBFS : +6 dB retrouve le: SACD 0 dB = −6 dBFS: +6 dB restores the PCM level. A 64-bit limiter (−0.2 dBFS ceiling) prevents any clipping.
Harmonique paire d'ordre 2 à −90 dB et d: 2nd-order even harmonic at −90 dB and −0.5 dB softening above 18 kHz. Off: minimum-phase filter only.
Sécurité RME DSD Direct (verrouiller le: RME DSD Direct safety (lock the software volume at 100 %)
Attention : en « DSD Direct », l'ADI-2 d: Warning: in « DSD Direct », the ADI-2 disables its hardware volume on the line outputs. NX Player's volume stays at 100 % (bit-perfect): set the level with an external analogue control.
Le DAC doit reconnaître les marqueurs Do: The DAC must recognise the DoP markers (0x05 / 0xFA); otherwise it plays low-level noise.
Memory Play : charger chaque morceau en: Memory Play: load each track into RAM
Le fichier entier est copié en mémoire a: The whole file is copied into memory when playback starts: no more disk or network access while listening. Data identical to the file (bit-perfect).
Un fichier plus gros (DSD512, DXD de plu: Larger files (DSD512, hours of DXD) are read from the disk.
L'ordinateur reste éveillé tant que la m: The computer stays awake while music plays (the display may turn off).
Filtre polyphase 64 bits, 160 dB. Rappor: 64-bit polyphase filter, 160 dB. Integer ratio (×2, ×4, ×8) within the same rate family. Disables bit-perfect.
Ajouter un dossier (disque interne, exte: Add a folder (internal or external drive, mounted SMB / NFS share)
Retirer les albums des serveurs indispon: Remove albums of unavailable / offline servers
Garde les serveurs connectés pendant cet: Keeps the servers connected during this session, removes the others. The files stay on the NAS.
Purger tous les éléments du NAS de la bi: Purge every NAS item from the library
Tous les albums importés d'un NAS / Jell: Every album imported from a NAS / Jellyfin will be removed from the library (the files stay on the server).
Les morceaux et albums téléchargés depui: Tracks and albums downloaded from a server are copied here (Artist / Album / original file) then added to the library, available offline.
Photos et biographies d'artistes en lign: Artist photos and biographies online (TheAudioDB, Wikipedia)
Seul le nom de l'artiste est envoyé. Les: Only the artist's name is sent. Answers are kept 30 days in the library.
Chercher les paroles en ligne (LRCLIB, p: Look for lyrics online (LRCLIB, then lyrics.ovh)
Fichier .lrc et tags d'abord, puis LRCLI: .lrc file and tags first, then LRCLIB (synced lyrics), then lyrics.ovh as a fallback (plain text). Artist, title, album and duration are sent to these services.
Plus de thèmes et plug-ins : barre latér: More themes and plug-ins: sidebar › Extensions & Themes.
Les thèmes (.nxtheme : immersive.json, -: Themes (.nxtheme: immersive.json, --nx-immersive-*) and plug-ins can change it too.
Un serveur web local démarre sur cet ord: A local web server starts on this computer: scan the QR code with your phone (same Wi-Fi network). Stopped when NX Player quits.
Contrôles de mastering, en 64 bits. Tout: Mastering checks, in 64-bit. Any active tool takes the stream out of bit-perfect (shown in the signal path); DSD is then converted to DXD.
Mélange une part filtrée de chaque voie: Blends a filtered share of each channel into the other, like speakers; inactive in mono.
Clic droit sur un morceau ou un album ›: Right click a track or an album › « Analyse / Convert in AuraEngine X »: the files open in the application (analysis, then DSD / PCM conversion).
Utilise JUCE (AGPLv3 / commercial), SQLi: Uses JUCE (AGPLv3 / commercial), SQLite (public domain), Apple ALAC (Apache 2.0), QR Code generator (Project Nayuki, MIT). See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Infos d'artistes : TheAudioDB et Wikipéd: Artist info: TheAudioDB and Wikipedia (CC BY-SA). Lyrics: LRCLIB, lyrics.ovh.
Outils Studio : mono, Mid / Side, phase,: Studio tools: mono, Mid / Side, phase, crossfeed
Volume numérique 64 bits. À 100 %, le fl: 64-bit digital volume. At 100 %, the stream stays bit-perfect.
Boucle : la fin B doit être après le déb: Loop: the end B must come after the start A
Volume verrouillé à 100 % par le profil: Volume locked at 100 % by the RME profile (DSD Direct): set the level in analogue.

Boucle A-B : 1er clic = début (I), 2e =: A-B loop: 1st click = start (I), 2nd = end and loop (O), 3rd = off (L)
le DAC est déjà réservé par un autre log: the DAC is already reserved by another application (Hog Mode)
Hog Mode refusé par le périphérique: Hog Mode refused by the device
Mixeur du système : ni exclusif ni bit-p: System mixer: neither exclusive nor bit-perfect
AuraEngine X : seuls les fichiers locaux: AuraEngine X: only local files can be sent (download the NAS track first)
AuraEngine X introuvable : indiquez son: AuraEngine X not found: set its location in Settings › Tools
pas de configuration FLAC (dfLa) dans le: no FLAC configuration (dfLa) in the stream
est déjà utilisé (une autre connexion e: is already in use (another sign-in in progress?)
délai dépassé : aucune réponse du naviga: timed out: no answer from the browser
renseignez le client_id fourni par Tidal: enter the client_id provided by Tidal
Tidal : flux chiffré (DRM), lecture impo: Tidal: encrypted stream (DRM), cannot be played outside the Tidal app
aucun client_id Spotify : cette version: no Spotify client_id: this build was compiled without NX_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, enter your own

— vérifiez que votre compte est ajouté: — check that your account is added under « User Management » in the Spotify application,
Spotify Premium est nécessaire pour lanc: Spotify Premium is required to start playback from NX Player: the track opens in Spotify.
Aucun appareil Spotify actif : ouvrez l': No active Spotify device: open the Spotify app, then try again.
Aucune réponse SSDP : vérifiez que le NA: No SSDP answer: check that the NAS is on the same network, or add its IP address.
